# Schedule manufacturing throughput attribution

Purpose: make total Git commit throughput across scheduled manufacturing runs directly observable and causally attributable in Project #2. Commit count is the primary external factory counter. Preserve total count first; classification is additional dimensional information, never a reason to discount commits.

## Mandatory ScheduleRun identity
Every hourly cell run MUST create one globally unique run_id = automation_id + scheduled_at UTC + cell. Record automation_id, cell, schedule minute, prompt title, prompt_digest, scheduled_at, started_at, finished_at, predecessor_run_id, standing. Every commit intentionally manufactured by the run SHOULD carry Git trailers `Schedule-Run: <run_id>` and `Schedule-Cell: <cell>` when repository policy permits. Merge commits and Project-memory transport commits that cannot carry the originating trailer must be linked by exact SHA in the run ledger.

## PRE snapshot
At run start record portfolio observation window and exact count state: observed_at, repository_universe_count, reachable_repository_count, pre_total_commits_1h, pre_total_commits_24h, previous_run_commits, previous_same_cell_commits, previous_hour_total_commits, repository_heads map, active branches/PRs relevant to the run.

## POST snapshot
At run finish record post_total_commits_1h, post_total_commits_24h, total_commit_delta_during_run, attributed_commit_count, unattributed_commit_count, first_attributed_commit_at, last_attributed_commit_at, manufacturing_duration_seconds, commits_per_run, commits_per_active_minute, rolling_commits_per_hour, delta_vs_previous_hour, delta_vs_previous_same_cell, delta_vs_24h_hourly_mean.

## Per-repository attribution
For each repository touched: repository, base_sha, first_sha, last_sha, branch, PR numbers, merge_sha, semantic_commits, qualification_commits, ggen_commits, generated_consumer_commits, Project-memory/control commits, merge_commits, total_commits, generated_consequence_count, packs reused/composed/extended/created, consumers qualified. These dimensions classify throughput but TOTAL_COMMITS remains authoritative factory output.

## GGEN/manufacturing dimensions
Record G = ggen-involved meaningful commits / meaningful commits; D = qualified structural displacements / admitted displacement candidates; F = qualified generated consumers / canonical structures; U = generalizable downstream refinements promoted upstream and regenerated / generalizable refinements observed; E,E2,Y,R,Q,C,M,V when available. Record commits caused by pack creation, regeneration fanout, upstream repair, downstream feedback, and factories-for-factories.

## OCEL v2 relations
ScheduleRun --produced--> Commit; ScheduleRun --touched--> Repository; Commit --belongs_to--> PullRequest; PullRequest --merged_as--> Commit; Commit --generated_from--> Pack/Generator; Commit --consumes--> ProjectMemory; ScheduleRun --read--> Memory; ScheduleRun --updated--> Memory; ScheduleRun --caused--> Opportunity; Pack --generated--> Consumer; AgentRefinement --generalizes_to--> Pack; Pack --regenerated_into--> Consumer. Preserve exact timestamps, qualifiers, provenance and supersession.

## Attribution law
Do not infer schedule causality from temporal proximity alone when an explicit run marker or exact run ledger is absent. Classify such commits as UNATTRIBUTED_OBSERVED. A run is throughput-measurable only when PRE + POST + exact commit set exist. Portfolio throughput is the union of unique commit SHAs across all repositories, never the sum of overlapping PR counts. Merge commits count as commits. Project-memory transport/receipt commits count in total manufacturing throughput and are separately classified.

## Treatment/version law
Every prompt/schedule mutation changes prompt_digest. Compare throughput only across explicit prompt versions and treatment windows. A schedule prompt changed after a run began cannot be credited/blamed for that run. Maintain pre-treatment and post-treatment cohorts for SPR, GGEN-saturation, OCEL/RevOps, and future schedule changes.

## Current baseline observation
2026-08-26T00:01:16Z..2026-08-26T01:01:16Z observed at least 185 unique commits across repositories pushed in-window: ggen-marketplace 122 (R72 53 + merge; R73 67 + merge) and chatgpt-cloud-elixir Project-memory/control 63. Previous-hour ggen-marketplace alone observed at least 244 commits from PRs #295-#298 plus merges, therefore the 185 current-hour total is below the previous-hour lower bound. The SPR/GGEN schedule rewrites occurred near the end of the current window and are NOT causally attributable to R72/R73; next complete hourly cycle is first post-treatment cohort.

## Control objective
Maximize total unique commits/hour, commits/run, commits/active-minute, repository fanout, G/D/F/U, and future commit-producing capacity. Falling throughput triggers Theory-of-Constraints diagnosis: opportunity starvation, serialization, schedule overlap/queueing, context reconstruction, qualification latency, PR/merge latency, GGEN underuse, insufficient consumer fanout, authority/tool constraints, or premature stopping. Never reinterpret falling commits as success without explicit causal evidence.

metadata.causal_marker: Schedule-Run git trailer plus exact Project #2 run ledger
